reasoning: On the season so far the Knicks are the stronger team; with home court the Knicks start about 10 points better, in a game of about 216 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 5 points towards the Pacers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Knicks win 70 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 190 and 238 total points.

analyst.text: The Knicks have won four straight, the last on Mikal Bridges' buzzer-beater against Portland on Saturday, but this is a back-to-back and Karl-Anthony Towns (illness) and OG Anunoby (calf) sat that game. Indiana have lost three straight, T.J. McConnell is out again with his hamstring and Pascal Siakam is questionable; Tyrese Haliburton is targeting a return before December. The angle leans towards New York on morale, even short-handed.
